integrity: The proof partitions all vertex subsets by the two center coordinates and checks the unique tree geodesics in each case. A separate checker reconstructs graph distances, tests every subset directly, and independently enumerates maximal general position sets.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ordinary general position sets in double stars with at least two leaves at each center.
Cases with one side of size one are excluded because they merge into the spider-tree regime.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= a,b <= 7 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed equivalent formula.
title: General position polynomial and maximal-set structure of double stars
